messages:
maria: Quick idea — want to prototype a tiny sample app that exercises replay-safe streaming + 429 jitter heuristics. Problem: token refreshes + client reconnects are causing duplicate completions in a few onboarding demos.

ajay: +1. Do you mean duplicates when a streaming connection resumes after auth refresh and the client resends the last chunk?

maria: Yeah. Example flow: client opens stream, gets partial tokens, refresh happens, client reconnects and replays the final request frame. Backend sometimes applies it twice.

ajay: We're already recommending Idempotency-Key for non-streaming, but streams are trickier. Proposed quick pattern: include a monotonic sequence header per logical request and keep a short sliding window server-side to dedupe. e.g.:
```
X-RW-Seq: 0000123
X-RW-Stream-ID: signup-flow-42
```
If seq <= last_seen(seq) within TTL => drop. TTL could be small (30s-2m) depending on latency.

simon: Server concerns: storing per-stream seqs for many short-lived clients can grow. For a lightweight approach we can use time-bucketed LRU sets (expire buckets every 10s) or a small Bloom filter per stream to avoid unbounded memory. Also track "last-applied-seq" and monotonic gaps to detect missed packets.

eli: Observability: we should emit an event when we detect a replay dedupe so DX teams can see how often this happens. Suggested span/tag names: `replay.detected`, `replay.reason=auth-refresh|client-resume|network-dup`. Also include the stream-id and seq in logs (PII-free).

monique: From a DX POV make default SDK behavior safe out-of-the-box. Two things: 1) default to exponential backoff with full jitter for 429/5xx, 2) add transparent stream sequence header automatic rotation when reconnecting so app authors don't have to think about it.

ajay: For backoff math I recommend: `sleep = random_between(0, base * 2^n)` (full jitter). Base=100ms, cap=5s for user-facing flows. For aggressive throughput endpoints maybe base=20ms cap=1s. We can provide these as named presets in SDKs.

maria: Can we also provide a tiny sample app "replay-garden" that shows: reconnect+resume, auth refresh, and server-side dedupe telemetry? Make it a button in the docs to reproduce.

simon: Ok, but the sample server should demonstrate both approaches: per-stream LRU window vs server-side global token with TTL so teams can pick. Include a script that floods reconnects to highlight false positives.

eli: Add a metric `replay.false_positives` for the sample so we don't tune heuristics into dropping legitimate retries. We'll need to show sensitivity plots (ttl vs fp rate).

monique: UX note — onboarding docs should explain when to use Idempotency-Key vs Sequence headers. Short checklist: streaming? use seq+stream-id. idempotent-rest? use idempotency-key. auth refresh? enable auto-replay-protection in SDK.

ajay: I'll sketch SDK patches: automatic X-RW-Stream-ID (UUID per logical user flow), monotonic seq, built-in jittered retry preset, and opt-in telemetry flag `rw.replay_protect=true`.

maria: Amazing. Who wants to pair on a 2-hour spike tomorrow? I can wire the sample UI.

simon: I can do server sketch + memory analysis.

eli: I'll add the metrics to the infra plan and mock dashboards.

monique: I'll draft short docs and the checklist.

ops-bot: Reminder: spike scheduled — calendar invite sent for 2026-05-03 10:00 UTC :calendar: 

maria: Thanks all — putting a small RFC in the docs repo after the spike.
